body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> The Joy Factory today unveiled its initial product suite of digital companion accessories for iPad™ and iPhone® users. The products, which range from 360-degree rotating stands and portfolios to waterproof cases and versatile mounting systems, are lifestyle driven and designed to enhance overall usability. The Joy Factory made its industry debut at The Digital Experience, the country's largest and best attended consumer electronics media event, which is held annually on the eve of the International Consumer Electronics Show.

"We launched The Joy Factory with the goal to bridge today's complex technology with its users by creating an emotional bond and joyful experience," said Sampson Yang, president of The Joy Factory and consumer electronics veteran. "Our products are designed to allow consumers to maximize use of their digital devices—whether it be at home, in the car, at the office or on-the-go. The Joy Factory accessories redefine the boundaries of use."
Caters to Consumers' Need to Use Digital Product Almost Anywhere

Designed to fit a variety of lifestyles and usage applications, The Joy Factory offers an array of smart phone and tablet specialty accessories, including protective cases and portfolios, rotating stands and mounting options designed for real-life settings. The cabinet-mounted solutions make viewing recipes in the kitchen a snap, while the waterproof iPhone case allows the "outdoor enthusiast turned professional" to check email from virtually any setting. And an auto carbon fiber mounting system will keep kids entertained while watching movies on the road.

The Joy Factory's products are ergonomically engineered, made of exquisitely crafted materials and developed for ease of use. The company's case and stand mounts feature the exclusive Snap-n-Roll™ design to provide an easy and secure attachment solution. Joytracer™, which is a unique identification and recovery system, provides peace of mind in the event the product is lost. And The Joy Factory's family of easy charging solutions keeps users' devices charged at maximum power capacity with an automatic surge protector to safeguard against harmful voltage fluctuations.
